'''Teldanus''' was the second-tallest [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peak located on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], rising some 7,350 meters tall. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] western hemisphere and its name translated into Basic as the "Overlook."
